interactions.note: The epitope-specific anti-gp350 hybridoma 72A1 as well as the human-mouse chimeric anti-gp350 IgG1 antibody constructed from that hybridoma blocked P3HR1 EBV superinfection of Raji cells.
The epitope-specific mAb S54 neutralized EBV infection of Raji B cells. MAb S54 showed relatively low neutralization at the high dose against infection of epithelial HNE1 cells.

The epitope-specific mAb S54 competed the binding of complement receptor 2 (CR2) binding to gp350. MAb S54  significantly reduced but did not completely abrogate the binding of soluble gp350 to Raji cells. MAb S54 did not inhibit gH/gL-mediated membrane fusion between the effector CHO-K1 and target HEK293 cells, expressing the gH/gL and gB fusion machinery.
